p225e88f904.notes: Shopping centre facade, Bogotá, with motion blur and a tree trunk in front. 'Centro Comercial' is in raised serif letters over the arch; the name logo on both sides of it uses decorative ligatures and oversized initials (big C and R, small-cap remainder, 'DE' and 'CANDELARIA' with joined letters), transcribed here as plain capitals. The small address plate over the gate (apparently 'CLL 12 6-45') is too blurred to transcribe. The 'Imple Joyeros' sign at right is a distractor.

p39b1437984.reason: busy pedestrian-street scene; the only signs are a small KFC logo at the edge and food-cart advertising, with no single target

p63bff90a90.notes: Blue-and-white panel over a stairway entrance at dusk, Bogotá, with some motion blur. No accents on the sign. The leading 'O' of 'ODONTOLOGICA' is half cut off by the left edge of the panel. The partial 'ZA...' store sign at right and the '36' logo above are distractors.

pd0c7166c5d.notes: Black fascia of a jewellery shop on Calle 12, Bogotá; slight motion blur. The apostrophe is a slanted tick (transcribed as ASCII). The tiny address under the name is unreadable. Distractors: 'J&A JOYERIA / Diamantes Y Esmeraldas' at left, 'COMPRO ORO / CALLE 12 Nº 6 65' at right, graffiti on the shutter.

ped7fce1f49.notes: Gold letters 'NALIA' with a lotus logo on a white fascia, right half of the frame, Bogotá. A blurred motorcyclist and pillion fill the left half. A smaller 'NALIA / JOYE...' panel and a 'SERVICIO TÉ... DE RELOJ...' panel (both cut at the edge), the '...oisson' sign at left and 'LIBRE' graffiti are distractors.

pf986069b59.reason: street-vendor cart menu (obleas, toppings) and pedestrians; no sign naming a place

p5b93c415d4.reason: street food-stall price boards (menus/adverts) and pedestrians; no place sign

c93980265.notes: Blue town welcome billboard at the entrance to Ubaté (Cundinamarca). Distractors: Cerveza Andina beer bottle ad on the left, water ad on the right, hand-painted 'VIVERO' banner and a yield sign below, partly hidden 'Alcaldía Munic...' sign behind.

c99399934.notes: Four green street-name blades on one pole at Calle 52 / Carrera 52 in central Medellín (two are angled). Rooftop letters 'NUTIBARA' of the Hotel Nutibara behind are a distractor.

c93303045.notes: Blue-and-white Talavera tile street plaque in La Candelaria, Bogotá. Small maker/donor text uses V for U ('INSTITVTO', 'CVLTVRA').

c93303130.notes: Broken-tile mosaic street plaque on a brick wall in La Candelaria, Bogotá; letters are made of black-and-white tesserae.

c13258882.notes: Neon guitar-shaped Hard Rock Cafe sign at night at the Atlantis Plaza mall entrance, Bogotá; the left edge of the logo is cropped. Mall lettering above is cut off ('...ntis Plaza').

c47289155.reason: Braille-only plate on a MIO bus-stop pole; no printed text

c102313210.notes: Illuminated green fascia with siren logo at night, Zona T, Bogotá; seen at an angle. Reflections of 'Cartier' signs in the glass and 'STARBUCKS' on the terrace screens are distractors.

CARACAS / 65A-66 / LOCAL 1y2' (the last token is tiny). Distractors: 'SOLO POR HOY EN ROPA DE MUJER' poster, neighbouring 'JyJ / CENTELSA' sign with 'v. caracas # 65A - 70', and a 'COMPRAMOS...' banner at right.
